_comment: AI-ASSISTED SCAFFOLD from CLARENCE_ZHEN_JIN_TAN_SPECIALISED_WORK_PACKAGE.md §12.2/§12.3/§12.6/§12.7/§12.9/§12.10 (C-15). NOT authorship evidence. Clarence prepares the ethics evidence pack; the Bristol PGT ethics route decides (RATIFY-15-03). No human-effect claim without approval.
intended_use: evidence-bounded discovery of published activity listings
research evaluation within the approved route
prohibited_use: emergency, clinical, diagnosis, prescribing or safeguarding decision
autonomous booking, payment, referral or contact
automatic acceptance of model or staff-assistant recommendations
reuse of research or operational data for a new purpose without review

activity_matrix.gate: do not publish member reactions as participant evidence
activity_matrix.fallback: treat as supervision, exclude from analysis

activity_matrix.gate: favourable Bristol PGT route before collection
activity_matrix.fallback: no usability/effect claim; deterministic + accessibility evidence only

activity_matrix.gate: no collection until purposes, notice, retention and approval established (DPIA, C-13)

responsible_ai_requirements: identify the system as automated and bounded
set accurate expectations about catalogue, freshness and scope
provide edit, challenge, correction and human/assisted routes
prohibit dark patterns, forced disclosure and attention capture
expose why a question is asked and allow skip where safe
never hide a deterministic option to manufacture chatbot engagement
preserve human approval for staff/external actions
non_compensatory: Passing one maturity gate never authorises the next; a favourable score elsewhere cannot offset a failed ethics, privacy, threat, disclosure, supplier, resilience, interaction, assurance-integrity or maturity gate. 'public_safe_demonstration' is a maturity-state name, not an unqualified safety claim.
incident_controls: immediate safe mode or kill switch
no_study_fallback: If ethics/recruitment/readiness fails: retain deterministic conformance, accessibility/AT, semantic-replay / non-interference / security tests; remove public-usability, practitioner-actionability, organisational-effectiveness and lived-equity claims (WP §13.5).
